Questions about living in Texas

What is the best city to live in Texas?

Among Texas cities with 50,000 or more people, Flower Mound scores highest with an A+. Among cities of 10,000 to 50,000, West University Place is first. Among towns of 1,000 to 10,000, Taylor Lake Village is first.

How do the big Texas cities grade?

Houston D+, San Antonio D, Dallas C-, Austin B-, Fort Worth D-, El Paso C+. Big cities are graded against other Texas cities of 50,000 or more, which includes many well-off suburbs, so their grades run lower. Their best neighborhoods often grade A.

How are these places ranked?

Each place gets ten grades: cost of living, jobs and income, schools, safety, errands and things to do, getting around, education levels, health, home ownership and internet access. The overall grade weights them, with cost, schools, income and safety counting most. You can change the weights with the sliders.
